title: Missing AVX-512 intrinsics from the avx512vl extension
author: Shnatsel
body_preview: The standard library is missing some AVX-512 intrinsics added in the avx512vl extension, introduced in Skylake-X. Not only are they not stabilized, the intrinsics are missing from stdarch entirely.  The VL extension for AVX-512 added the AVX-512 instruction variants for register sizes smaller than AVX-512.
